entry.author: Eastern Institute Of Technology
entry.summary:
From coding self-driving cars in our robotics lab to scrubbing in and developing practical skills in our vet nursing clinics, this week’s EIT Taster Days gave students a hands-on taste of what studying at EIT is really like. 💻🩺🏉

Ngā mihi to our staff, students and whānau who helped make the experience possible. 💙

Missed out? Join us at our Info & Enrolment Day on 17 September. Tour the campus, meet our tutors and discover the study options that could shape your future.

See you there!

#EIT #TasterDays #FutureStudents #StudyLocal #HawkesBay
